description:
Hello! We are NASA 38TR, a team of five students from Kayseri, Türkiye. We are interested in space, science, technology, and coding.

Our project is about keeping astronauts healthy and safe in space. We want to create an AI-powered health monitoring system that checks astronauts’ heart rate, oxygen level, body temperature, and stress level. Our goal is to find possible health problems early and warn astronauts before they become serious.

We love teamwork, learning new things.

details:
Project Details – ASTROGUARD AI

How does our project work?

ASTROGUARD AI is designed to help astronauts stay healthy and safe in space. Our interactive project shows how AI can monitor health information, including heart rate, blood oxygen, body temperature, and stress levels. It aims to detect unusual changes and provide early warnings.

Our Innovative Ideas

* Smartwatch: Allows astronauts to check health information and receive alerts.

* Smart Lens: A futuristic concept that could display health updates, space information, and safety warnings.

* My Digital Twin: A virtual astronaut that shows body systems and helps users understand their health.

* AI Health Assistant: Offers helpful suggestions and supports astronauts’ well-being.

Tools and Technology

We used Canva to design and present our interactive project and Microsoft PowerPoint to explain our ideas. Our concept also explores artificial intelligence, health monitoring software, and digital simulations.

Why is our project important?

Astronauts face physical and mental challenges during long space missions. Our goal is to identify possible health risks early, support astronauts, and make space exploration safer.

What makes our project creative?

We combine AI, a digital astronaut, smartwatch technology, and a futuristic smart lens in one health monitoring concept.

Our project is an educational prototype, and some advanced features are ideas for future development.

Our Mission: Because Every Heartbeat Matters!
